answer: The terrace schedule is applied in lotus and vertex reveals each instalment. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split thus 56% arrives at settlement and the rest over 16 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2840 identities would post 3212 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
